{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders and QA orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']
qa_filter = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99

# Remove QA orders
cleaned_orders = completed_orders[~qa_filter]

# Now compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = cleaned_orders.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()
print(revenue_by_channel)"}
